title: Tere Sadqay Main Zahra Ho Raha hai
body:
Tere Sadqay Main Zahra Ho Raha hai
Khuda Ko Jo Bhi Sajda Ho Raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
●Teri Chadar Kay Saye Main Aey Bibi
Khuda Walo Ka Jalsa Ho Raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
●Musalmano Phiray Tum Fatima Say
Tumharay Sath Acha Ho Raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
●Tujhay Abbas Ki Maa Keh Raha Hun
Talab Mujhsay Hawala Ho Raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
●Ali Walay Jina Main Ja Rahai Hain
Jo Waada Tha Woh Pura Ho Raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
●Kisi Mukhtar Ko Bhaijain Aey Bibi
Hamara Shehar Kufa Ho Raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
●Imam Asr Ajayain Khudara
Ali Walo Main Jhagra Ho Raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
●Aey Mufti Rok Lai Salman Ko Ja
Dar e Zehra Pay Sajda Ho Raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
●Tairi Chaki Kay Chakar Main Aey Bibi
Jahan Ka Rizq Pura Ho Raha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
●Ba Faiz e Fatima Zehra Takallum
Tairay Shero'n Ka Charcha Ho Raha hai
author: Mir Hassan Mir
